Realistic Implementation. --- To demonstrate that the staggered bianisotropy underlying the antihelical edge states can be implemented in a realistic photonic structure, we construct a metacrystal composed of electromagnetic-dual metaatoms.
CLM-PHOT-0152.statement: The realistic metacrystal based on split-ring metaatoms exhibits a Dirac-point frequency of approximately 5 GHz in the microwave regime.

extra_quotes: Full-wave simulations confirm the corresponding bulk and edge behaviors.

Notably, the spin-polarized Dirac crossings of the SP-DSM phase are maintained only when the two pseudospin channels remain decoupled under electromagnetic duality (𝜀ˆ = 𝜇ˆ) and the staggered magnetoelectric couplings remain balanced (𝜁(1) = −𝜁(2)). Breaking duality hybridizes the TE±TM channels, while an imbalance 𝜁(1) ≠ −𝜁(2) generates an effective mass term and opens a Dirac gap.
